## D — Accuracy and Verification, Section Fourteen Defensive driving and weather

Section D records the accuracy posture for the Section Fourteen Defensive driving and weather dossier. Every knowledge fact is required to trace to its cited physical handbook page, with the cited page stating the fact. Confidence is high across the section because every rule comes from the single pinned handbook edition, and every number is spelled out in words so that the card backs read aloud exactly. The extracted text of these pages carries a font-encoding shift that turns commas into line breaks and garbles a few words into offset letters; the dossier author decoded the shift deterministically before reading and asserts no rule from any residue that stayed unreadable. The flash flood fatality share is carried as the handbook's own statement without independent verification. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, image or question is reproduced. The inspection interval is stated as the pinned edition prints it; no time-variable fact beyond that edition appears, so nothing required isolation as dynamic knowledge.

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so the Section Fourteen Defensive driving and weather content changes at most with a new edition.
